name: @pipeworx/mcp-radio

tools.name: search_stations
tools.description: Search radio stations by name. Returns station name, URL, country, genres, and popularity vote count. Use when looking for a specific station or browsing by keyword.

limit.description: Maximum number of results to return. Defaults to 10.

tools.name: get_top_stations
tools.description: Get trending radio stations ranked by popularity, optionally filtered by country (e.g., 'US', 'GB', 'DE'). Returns station URLs, genres, and vote counts.

count.description: Number of stations to return. Defaults to 10.

country.description: Filter by country name (e.g. "Germany", "United States"). Omit for global results.

tools.name: list_countries
tools.description: Browse available countries with radio stations. Returns country names and station counts to help target your search geographically.

tools.name: list_tags
tools.description: Discover radio genres and tags ranked by station count. Use to explore what categories are available before searching.

limit.description: Maximum number of tags to return. Defaults to 20.

instructions: @pipeworx/mcp-radio forwards to the Pipeworx gateway and lists only the radio pack's tools. Set PIPEWORX_META_TOOLS=1 to also list ask_pipeworx and the other gateway-wide tools.
